title: Integration: the merger rebases the PR on main, runs lint and test on the merged tree, squash-merges, cleans up; merged 200 or merge.conflict 409
text: Owner, chat 2026-10-10 UTC: 'we should have an integration node in DAG'. The node between review.passed 201 and verified 201 in WFL-sdlc. Input: review.passed 201 with the pr. Steps: fetch main, rebase the branch, make lint and make test on the merged tree, gh pr merge --squash, work-order.sh cleanup, slot.sh release. Output: merged 200 (routes to the architect for verify) or merge.conflict 409 (routes to the worker with the record). Never merges a PR whose tests did not run on the merged tree.
